item.title: Multiple Toronto hotels were just ranked among the best in the world in 2026
item.description: Toronto has officially secured multiple spots on one of the world's most prestigious hospitality lists. This week, Forbes Travel Guide unveiled the 68th edition of its annual 2026 Star Awards, recognizing hundreds of hotels, restaurants, and spas around the world that offer exceptional service and experiences. Forbes inspectors visited every property, including those in Toronto, in person, posing as everyday guests to analyze everything from hotel rooms to spa treatments and dining experiences.
